name: Roo Code

skills.notes: Per-mode directories `.roo/skills-<mode>` and `.agents/skills-<mode>` exist; `.roo` wins over `.agents` at the same level. The docs moved to GitHub Pages in 2026.

notes: Roo keeps every custom mode in one .roomodes file and merges: entries whose slug starts with waypost- are ours, everything else is left alone. Roo now prefers YAML but JSON is documented as fully supported and not deprecated, so waypost writes JSON — it can be produced and re-read without a YAML parser, and this tool ships no dependencies. If your .roomodes is already YAML, waypost refuses to touch it rather than converting it; convert it to JSON or invoke roles with `waypost agents show`. groups read+command keep the mode read-only apart from the shell. the rules directory is the documented location; AGENTS.md support is not established.
